question: Should this release remove the listed shipped root skills and designate Sherpa ONNX TTS as an official ClawHub-only plugin?
rationale: Code review cannot choose whether existing users should absorb this compatibility break or whether the new official package and native-download trust boundary is an accepted product commitment.

options.title: Migrate, prove, then land
options.body: Keep the combined direction, but require doctor migration, fresh-install and upgrade proof, current-head dependency authorization, and Sherpa package/artifact verification before merge.

options.title: Split Sherpa packaging
options.body: Move the Sherpa official-plugin work into a focused PR and defer the broader bundled-skill deprecation until its migration plan is ready.

options.title: Park the broad trim
options.body: Retain the current bundled set and close or pause this draft until a release-owned deprecation policy is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Migrate, prove, then land
recommendation.body: Keep the combined direction, but require doctor migration, fresh-install and upgrade proof, current-head dependency authorization, and Sherpa package/artifact verification before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the merged precursor slices and explicitly defined the remaining decision surface in this PR discussion.
